svg.metadata: {"story":"Moses","act":5,"chapter":"Ch.5 · Through the Sea","scene":"B","layer":"foreground","artDirection":"The pillar of cloud goes behind, the sea is divided, and the people cross on dry ground; the waters return over the chariots. Stage: a sea with walls of water, a people walking on the seabed at night, the cloud lighting the way, the horses and the chariots drowned in the morning; a world of water held back.","materials":["assets/materials/egypt_mud_brick-stretcher.svg","assets/materials/stone_tablets-hewn.svg"],"seed":1}
